name: balanced_geometry_v9
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: On all 55 development systems, the twofold vector and distance edit improves R/S and median bond and angle error, but not full E/Z. Fourfold input vectors improve full E/Z but exceed the protein displacement limit and slightly worsen bond error. Use an intermediate threefold input vector gain and retain the tested twofold denoiser distance gain. This tests whether strengthening relative metric geometry offsets the geometric cost of the handedness pathway.
